# ros2_control Documentation

> ros2_control is a framework for real-time control of robots using ROS 2. It provides hardware abstraction, a controller manager, and a set of standard controllers for common robot hardware.

## Versioning and Migration
APIs and hardware interfaces differ significantly between ROS 2 distributions. Always consult the version-specific changelogs and migration paths before generating C++ configurations:
- [Release Notes](doc/release_notes/release_notes.html)
- [Migration Guides](doc/migration/migration.html)
- [Differences to ROS 1 (ros_control)](doc/migration/differences_to_ros1.html)
